global.title: D2D satellite operators need to look behind MNOs to reach their full business potential
global.summary: Direct-to-device (D2D) services are primarily provided to end-users by Mobile Network Operators (MNOs). That’s because they are a valuable enhancement of terrestrial cellular services, making it logical that almost all D2D satellite operators focus their distribution on these MNOs. However new providers of telecommunications communications services besides MNOs have emerged over the last few years.
